## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 42 user-facing changes.
### New
- Let extensions sign you in silently through their web authentication flow, so Claude stays signed in across launches - Organize open tabs in named, colored folders that sync and move between saved and open tabs - Keep videos visible in native Picture in Picture when switching Mac tabs, with an option to turn automatic entry off
### Improved
- Keep one extension sidebar open in each Space and switch assistants from the toolbar - Move tabs and whole folders through the sidebar with clearer placement and immediate access after mobile drops
### Fixed
- Deliver messages from websites embedded in an extension’s side panel back to that extension, as Chrome does - Let extensions group tabs and open side panels in your window even while one of their popup windows has focus - Give extensions with a module background worker the same tab grouping surface as classic workers, so Claude's browser tools can anchor to a tab group - Improve Claude and ChatGPT browser tools, sign-in, page reading and screenshots - Keep website styling extensions from changing other extensions’ sidebars - Support extensions such as SponsorBlock that use relative background-worker paths - Recover synced open-tab folders after updating Crest and handle unsupported folder records on older versions
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
